knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Description

Adjusts a time series of nominal values for inflation by converting them into real purchasing-power terms. The function returns inflation-adjusted values for each observation in the input vector.

## Usage

```{r}
adjust_inflation(amounts, inflation_rate, years)
```

## Arguments

- `amounts`: Numeric vector of nominal values over time.
- `inflation_rate`: Annual inflation rate, expressed as a decimal.
- `years`: Unused in the current implementation. Included in the signature but not required for the calculation.

## Value

A numeric vector of inflation-adjusted values corresponding to the input amounts.

## Example

```{r}
real_wealth <- adjust_inflation(wealth, inflation_rate = 0.02, years = 30)
real_wealth
```
